notes: Unified from the Claude Design prototype (_source/design-dataset.js) into the canonical schema. 6 journeys. Fees/timelines/rules are MODELED, not verified (D6: domain reviewers). English strings are inline here (source); Kinyarwanda lives in locales/rw.json (D7).

artifacts.name: Lease or land title for premises

services.name: Decide legal structure
services.desc: Sole proprietor (just you) vs a company with partners. This quietly changes several later steps.

rules.message: Picking 'company' when you meant just yourself asks for directors & articles you don't have.
rules.mitigation: Pick sole proprietor unless you have partners or need to raise capital.

services.name: Verify National ID
services.desc: Your identity is the root of every step. Foreigners use a residence permit.

rules.message: An expired ID, or a name spelled differently from the NIDA record, gets rejected.
rules.mitigation: Check your ID is valid and the name matches exactly before starting.

rules.message: Foreign nationals need the right permit (and may only hold land on leasehold).
rules.mitigation: Confirm your residence/permit status first.

services.name: Secure proof of premises
services.desc: A lease or land title for where the business will operate. You arrange this yourself.

rules.message: Reaching the license steps with no lease/title in hand stalls everything.
rules.mitigation: Sort out premises early — it blocks two later steps.

services.name: Reserve business name
services.desc: Check the name is available and allowed.

rules.message: Names that clash with an existing business, or use restricted words (Bank, National, Rwanda…), are refused.
rules.mitigation: Have two or three backup names ready.

services.name: Register the business (RDB)
services.desc: The actual registration. Free, and issues your certificate + tax number. Most people think this is the whole job — it isn't.

rules.message: Wrong activity code for what you actually do.
rules.mitigation: Describe the business plainly; we suggest the right code.

rules.message: Company route needs full shareholding, directors and articles.
rules.mitigation: Use the standard articles template if you have no lawyer.

services.name: VAT registration
services.desc: Required once yearly sales pass ~RWF 20M.

rules.message: Crossing the threshold without registering builds up quiet penalties.
rules.mitigation: Register and get an EBM device when sales grow.

services.name: Trading license (district)
services.desc: A separate annual district license. The RDB certificate does NOT let you operate on its own.

rules.message: No proof of premises (lease/title) → refused.
rules.mitigation: Bring your lease or title.

rules.message: Location not zoned for the activity (e.g. a bar near a school).
rules.mitigation: Check zoning before signing a lease.

services.name: Health / hygiene permit
services.desc: Food businesses need a hygiene inspection & permit. The step people most often don't know exists.

rules.message: Opening on just the RDB certificate means operating illegally until an inspector arrives.
rules.mitigation: You are NOT done until this permit is in hand.

services.name: Register staff with RSSB
services.desc: Social security registration once you employ people.

rules.message: Hiring without registering staff is a liability on inspection.
rules.mitigation: Register employees from day one.

services.name: Open business bank account
services.desc: Needs your certificate, TIN and ID.

rules.message: Banks refuse if the registered name doesn't match your ID.
rules.mitigation: Keep names identical across documents.

services.name: Get EBM e-invoicing device
services.desc: Electronic billing device for VAT-registered businesses.

services.name: Verify land title & ownership
services.desc: Confirm the seller is really the registered owner of the parcel (UPI).

rules.message: If the title isn't in the seller's name, the sale can't proceed.
rules.mitigation: Look up the UPI and confirm the owner before paying anything.

services.name: Encumbrance / dispute check
services.desc: Is the parcel mortgaged, under caveat, or disputed? Buyers routinely skip this and pay first.

rules.message: A mortgage, caveat or dispute blocks the transfer until cleared.
rules.mitigation: Always run this check before money changes hands.

services.name: Mortgage release / bank consent
services.desc: If the land secures a loan, the lender must release or consent.

rules.message: No settled loan / written lender consent → blocked.
rules.mitigation: Start the lender conversation early; it's slow.

services.name: Obtain spousal consent
services.desc: Under community-of-property marriage the spouse must consent to the sale.

rules.message: A married seller selling without the spouse's consent is the #1 land-transfer rejection.
rules.mitigation: Get the spouse's signed, notarized consent before the agreement.

services.name: Co-owner / family consent
services.desc: Co-owned or family land needs every co-owner's consent.

rules.message: Any co-owner who hasn't consented can block the sale.
rules.mitigation: List all co-owners from the title and collect each consent.

services.name: Land tax / lease-fee clearance
services.desc: Outstanding land lease fees & property tax must be cleared first — a frequent surprise.

rules.message: Arrears block the transfer.
rules.mitigation: Pull the balance owed on the parcel and settle it.

services.name: Notarize the sale agreement
services.desc: Authenticate the contract. Required consents must be attached.

rules.message: An unauthenticated agreement, or missing consents, is refused.
rules.mitigation: Bring all consents to the notary.

services.name: Pay land transfer fee
services.desc: Pay the transfer / registration fee.

rules.message: Wrong fee or unmatched payment causes rework.
rules.mitigation: We compute the expected fee and payment reference.

services.name: Apply for transfer (RLMUA)
services.desc: The step people THINK is 'the transfer'. RLMUA updates the register and issues the new title.

rules.message: Submitting without every required attachment gets rejected.
rules.mitigation: We only let you submit once everything for your situation is ready.

services.name: Get hospital birth notification
services.desc: The maternity facility issues a notification of birth — the source document the registrar needs.

rules.message: Leaving the facility without the notification means coming back for it.
rules.mitigation: Ask for the notification before you go home.

services.name: Arrange home-birth witnesses
services.desc: A birth outside a health facility is proven with witnesses and confirmation from your cell, instead of a hospital notification.

rules.message: No hospital notification and no witnesses means the registrar can't confirm the birth.
rules.mitigation: Line up witnesses and your cell leader's confirmation early.

services.name: Gather both parents' IDs
services.desc: Both parents' National IDs are needed to link the child to its parents.

services.name: Bring parents' marriage certificate
services.desc: When the parents are married, their marriage certificate records the child under both parents automatically.

services.name: Father acknowledges the child
services.desc: When parents aren't married, the father must formally acknowledge the child for his name to appear — otherwise the child is registered under the mother only.

rules.message: Skipping this leaves the father off the certificate, which is hard to fix later.
rules.mitigation: Sort out acknowledgement before the declaration if the father is to be named.

services.name: Get court order for late birth
services.desc: Past the legal 30-day window, a birth can only be registered with a court ruling — a long detour many families don't expect.

rules.message: After 30 days the registrar cannot register the birth without a court order.
rules.mitigation: Declare within 30 days to avoid court entirely.

services.name: Declare the birth (sector)
services.desc: Declare the birth at the sector civil registry. This is the core step — within 30 days it's quick and free.

rules.message: Late declarations are refused without the court order.
rules.mitigation: Bring the court ruling if the child is over 30 days old.

services.name: Get the birth certificate
services.desc: The civil registrar issues the certificate — your goal.

services.name: Choose passport type & apply
services.desc: Pick ordinary passport or East African travel document, new or renewal, and start the online application.

rules.message: Picking the wrong type or category means redoing the application.
rules.mitigation: Most travellers need the ordinary passport.

services.name: Gather the child's documents
services.desc: A child's passport needs the birth certificate, both parents' IDs, and signed guardian consent — gather these before enrolment.

rules.message: Missing parental consent or birth certificate stops a minor's application.
rules.mitigation: Both parents (or legal guardian) must consent for a minor.

services.name: Surrender your old passport
services.desc: Renewals require handing in the old passport (or a police report if it was lost) — easy to overlook.

rules.message: A renewal without the old passport (or loss report) is held up.
rules.mitigation: Bring the old passport; report it first if lost.

services.name: Pay the passport fee
services.desc: Pay based on the service speed you chose. Express costs more but is much faster.

rules.message: Express fees are significantly higher.
rules.mitigation: Only pay for express if you truly need the speed.

services.name: Capture biometrics
services.desc: Photo, fingerprints and signature captured at an enrolment centre.

rules.message: Non-compliant photos (glasses, headwear) are rejected on the spot.
rules.mitigation: Follow the photo rules: no glasses, plain background.

services.name: Vetting & printing
services.desc: Immigration vets the application and prints the passport. Express applications are prioritized here.

services.name: Collect your passport
services.desc: Pick up your finished passport — your goal.

services.name: Choose licence category
services.desc: Motorcycle (A), car (B) or commercial (C/D) — your category sets which test and medical you need.

services.name: Convert your foreign licence
services.desc: Holders of a valid foreign licence can convert it instead of sitting the theory and practical exams — many don't realise this shortcut exists.

rules.message: An expired or unrecognised foreign licence can't be converted — you'd take the full exams instead.
rules.mitigation: Check your licence is valid and from a recognised country.

services.name: Get medical fitness certificate
services.desc: A certificate of fitness to drive — often forgotten until exam day, when it's required to sit.

rules.message: Applicants who arrive for the practical without a medical are turned away.
rules.mitigation: Get it before you book the practical exam.

services.name: Pass the theory exam
services.desc: Pass the highway-code theory test to earn your provisional permit.

rules.message: Failing means re-booking and re-paying for another sitting.
rules.mitigation: Practise with the official question bank first.

services.name: Pass the practical exam
services.desc: The on-road driving test. You need a provisional permit and a valid medical to sit.

rules.message: Booking before you've practised enough usually means a re-sit.
rules.mitigation: Log real practice hours on a provisional permit first.

services.name: Pay the licence fee
services.desc: Pay the issuance fee once you've passed (or converted).

services.name: Get your driving licence
services.desc: The licence is printed and issued — your goal.

services.name: Get certificate of celibacy
services.desc: Each partner proves single status at their sector — a step couples often discover only when booking.

rules.message: An unresolved prior marriage blocks this certificate.
rules.mitigation: Each partner gets their own celibacy certificate from their sector.

services.name: Prove a prior marriage ended
services.desc: If either partner was married before, you need the divorce decree or the late spouse's death certificate.

rules.message: Without proof a prior marriage ended, the new marriage can't be registered.
rules.mitigation: Track down the divorce ruling or death certificate early — it can be slow.

services.name: Certificate of no impediment
services.desc: A foreign partner needs a certificate of no impediment from their embassy, plus valid residence — the longest pole for mixed couples.

rules.message: Many embassies are slow to issue this; without it the ceremony can't go ahead.
rules.mitigation: Start with the foreign partner's embassy weeks in advance.

services.name: Choose your property regime
services.desc: Couples choose how property is owned (community of property, limited community, or separation) before a notary. Skipped by many, it quietly shapes everything you own together.

rules.message: No explicit choice defaults you to full community of property.
rules.mitigation: Discuss and decide the regime before the ceremony.

services.name: Book the marriage & banns
services.desc: Book a date with the civil registrar. Your intention to marry (banns) is published for a notice period before the date.

rules.message: The banns notice period means you can't marry on short notice.
rules.mitigation: Book well ahead of any planned celebration.

services.name: Arrange two witnesses
services.desc: A civil marriage needs two witnesses with valid IDs present on the day.

services.name: Civil marriage ceremony
services.desc: The registrar celebrates the marriage and issues the certificate — your goal.

journeys.name: Open a business / restaurant
journeys.blurb: Register and legally operate a small business.

journeys.name: Transfer land ownership
journeys.blurb: Buy, sell, or transfer a plot into a new name.

journeys.name: Register a birth
journeys.blurb: Declare a newborn and get a birth certificate.

journeys.blurb: Get a Rwandan passport for travel.

journeys.blurb: From provisional to full driving license.
